name: acts
description: Generic Acts kernel. The $acts feature gives any $space subclass an internal, schema-validated, fail-closed emission primitive on its own sequenced log. $projection binds one source-space authority to single-writer folds, bounded views, and incremental idempotent rebuild from recorded observations. Domain classes, schemas, and concrete projections live in consuming catalogs; outliner is the first real adopter and casework is the temporary proof set.

features.description: Stateless feature carrying the internal act-emission primitive. Mounted on a $case (or any $space subclass that adopts the kernel), its effective surface is <space>:act. Emission requires a sequenced turn on the consumer's own log and an internal caller; payloads validate against event_schema; attached projections fold in the same turn, fail-closed.

classes.description: Base class for act projections (ACT4): one non-public source_space binding, consumes + internal fold, rows + bounded view, and incremental rebuild. Projection configuration and state are perms-empty; only the bound composer may fold. Rebuild is source-mediated, so it never grants the projection a self-fold capability. The projection lives in its source room's anchor cluster so fold writes share the turn's atomicity.

properties.name: source_space
properties.description: The sole composer authority allowed to fold this projection, both live and during source-mediated rebuild. Set when the projection is created.
